title: TinySocs Alert Document
description: Schema for documents indexed into tinysocs-alerts-* indices. Each document represents a single detection alert generated by the TinySocs Agent detection engine when a rule's threshold is met.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the alert was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: Deterministic alert ID in the format '{rule_id}|{group_key}|{window_start}'. Used as the OpenSearch document _id to prevent duplicates.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the alert means.

event_count.description: Number of events that matched the rule condition within the detection window.

first_seen.description: Timestamp of the first matching event in the detection window.

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the most recent matching event in the detection window.

window_start.description: Start of the detection time window in which events were aggregated.

source.description: Grouping key-value pairs that identify what entity triggered the alert (e.g., {'TargetUserName': 'admin'}). Contents depend on the rule's group_by field.

matched_events.description: Total number of events matched (may differ from alert.event_count if deduplication was applied).
